basis.text: 参考文献应指向真实存在的文献；规则32使用SerpAPI Google Scholar按标题、标题+作者姓氏、DOI进行有界检索，全部成功检索且无匹配结果时判定引用不存在；接口失败不作不存在结论。

bibliography_fields.description: Fields transcribed from the entry. Absent means absent from this text, not absent from the external work. Unknown extraction remains unknown.

bibliography_order.description: Position in bibliography and numeric entry label; nonnumeric labels give unknown numeric_value.

bibliography_shape.description: Observed notation and declared medium. system is numeric or author_year. DOI itself does not imply electronic medium. This capability does not return a rule verdict.

citation_order.description: Rank of first appearance of each distinct citation key, only known when citation source coverage is complete.

citation_relevance.description: This use purpose versus the identified work content. Supports methods, background, criticism, comparison and disagreement. Missing details/metadata or global topic mismatch are not negative proof.

citation_syntax.description: Notation tokens, not conformance. system is numeric or author_year; form is bracketed, parenthetical, or narrative. opening and closing are FIRST and LAST characters of the ENTIRE marker text, NOT the first parenthesis found within it. For narrative Smith (2020), opening is S; inspect year parentheses using matches on node.text. separators and range_separators may be empty. Automatic-footnote status is unknown unless established from source.

external_work.description: Publicly corroborated identity. Rule 32 uses the SerpAPI Google Scholar provider with bounded title, author, and DOI query fallbacks. Only a complete set of successful empty responses is a negative existence fact; API failures remain UNKNOWN. available_fields is an OPEN-WORLD partial list of positively confirmed metadata.

rule_text: 参考文献应指向真实存在的文献；规则32使用SerpAPI Google Scholar按标题、标题+作者姓氏、DOI进行有界检索，全部成功检索且无匹配结果时判定引用不存在；接口失败不作不存在结论。
